title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Jalan Raya, the road trip. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Jalan Raya
options.lineage: Malaysian road signs: green direction boards, brown tourist signs, gantries
options.thesis: The collection is a drive through Malaysia: places are exits, and every object has its own brown attraction sign.
options.viewport: A green overhead gantry is the navigation (Skyline, Old KL, On the road, Kopitiam, Kampung); below it the first exit's objects stand on the verge under brown signs, one turning live.
options.risk: Road signs are public works; set timidly they read as a ministry site, and too much sign green drowns the models' own colour.

raised.raise: Status is sign form, not colour: In review is a temporary-works sign, a cleared download is a full direction board.
Every model has a kilometre stone with its catalogue number, and you can key a number to jump straight there.
Sign colours own whole regions: each exit is painted its board colour edge to edge, never a sticker on grey.
Measurements are signs pinned to the model: a height-limit roundel and a width marker on the viewer.
The exit you are in lights its gantry board; the others stay matte.

options.label: Kaki Lima
options.lineage: shophouse signboards along a five-foot way
options.thesis: Walk a shophouse row: every place is a shop with its stacked signboard, and its objects sit in the arcade in front.
options.viewport: A row of shopfronts across the top, each signboard a place in Malay and English; under the arcade the first shop's objects, one live.
options.risk: The most familiar Malaysia-heritage look, and where most runs on this subject land; set softly it turns into a nostalgia postcard.

options.label: Title-card wall
options.thesis: Every place is a row of posters; the one you land on grows and tells you what it is.
options.viewport: Rows titled Skyline, Kopitiam, On the road, each a strip of model posters; the focused one enlarges with its name.
options.case: Holds clarity: rows by place are instantly browsable. Loses identification: nothing in it is Malaysian but the posters.
options.risk: Reads as any streaming app, and dark rows push the asset-store feel you want to avoid.

options.label: Emission-line rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail of hairlines.
options.viewport: One rail with each model as a tick; the open one blooms into a plate.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither makers nor the public meet Malaysia on a spectrogram.
options.risk: Cold and abstract next to warm everyday objects.
options.kept: State by form, not hue: In review is a temporary-works sign.

options.label: Teletext
options.thesis: Every model is a numbered page you key directly.
options.viewport: Page 100 index with models as numbered rows.
options.case: Fuses poorly: block mosaics fight 3D models, and teletext is not a Malaysian memory.
options.kept: Direct addressing: key a kilometre-stone number to jump to any model.

options.label: Duotone tech spread
options.thesis: Two fluorescent inks for absolutely everything.
options.viewport: Angled headline over a three-column spread.
options.case: Fuses poorly: duotone would repaint the models' real colours.
options.risk: Hides what the objects look like.
options.kept: Total palette commitment: sign colours own whole regions.

options.label: Tensegrity column
options.thesis: A strut network where every value is pinned to its node.
options.viewport: A force diagram with labels on leader lines.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no visitor's Malaysia lives in a strut network.
options.kept: Values pinned to the object: height and width signs on the viewer.

options.label: Sewing-pattern envelope
options.thesis: Views A, B and C on the envelope, the chosen one traced solid.
options.viewport: An envelope front indexing the views.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dressmaking is not how anyone meets these objects.
options.kept: The chosen state solid, the rest matte: the current exit lights its board.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A 3D asset library done impeccably: a filterable grid of thumbnails and a clean viewer page.
canonCard.viewport: Search and category filters over an even grid of model thumbnails.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Sketchfab or Poly Haven by design, and no sense of wandering.
